title: Cartography
description: A map is a projection: a round planet drawn on a flat sheet, and every projection trades one truth for another. The first study of the Earth sciences. Unlocks the Survey Map.

puzzle.goal: A map that keeps every angle true (so a compass course is a straight line) must stretch north-south distances more and more towards the poles. On a sphere of radius R, write how far up the map a point at latitude φ is drawn.
puzzle.name: Conformal cylindrical projection
puzzle.ask: Find Y in kilometres for latitude 45° (@{φ} rad) on a planet of radius R km.
puzzle.method: Keeping angles means the north-south stretch at each latitude must equal the east-west one, 1/cos φ: integrate R/cos φ from the equator.
